sum: Lead Real Estate Co., Ltd together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells residential properties in Japan. It develops single-family homes and condominiums in Japan. The company also develops and operates hotels in Tokyo, Kanagawa prefecture, and Sapporo. In addition, it leases apartment building units in Japan and Dallas, Texas. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
ceo: Mr. Eiji  Nagahara (CEO, President & Representative Director)
